verdict.rationale: Honeycomb documents a public API for building integrations and automating workflows, covering programmatic management of datasets, queries, triggers, SLOs, environments, and API keys, with a downloadable OpenAPI spec (docs-11, docs-21, docs-27). Supporting evidence includes curl/CLI-driven marker CRUD (docs-37) and OTLP ingest over HTTP/gRPC (docs-2). The probe's 404s on guessed OpenAPI paths do not contradict the documented spec download, so they are not a dispute. Missing for 10: endpoint-level detail such as auth and rate limits, and independent hands-on corroboration of driving the product via the API.
